command: cat influx.yaml; kubectl -n telemetry-8fb7 get sts,pvc,pods
kubectl get sc standard -o jsonpath='{.allowVolumeExpansion}'; echo; kubectl -n telemetry-8fb7 exec influx-0 -- cat /data/payload.txt

cd <job>/tmp/k8s/p1runs/se48fb7/cwd
kubectl -n telemetry-8fb7 patch pvc data-influx-0 -p '{"spec":{"resources":{"requests":{"storage":"128Mi"}}}}'
kubectl -n telemetry-8fb7 delete sts influx --cascade=orphan

kubectl -n telemetry-8fb7 apply -f <job>/tmp/k8s/p1runs/se48fb7/cwd/influx.yaml; sleep 15; kubectl -n telemetry-8fb7 get sts,pvc,pods; kubectl -n telemetry-8fb7 exec influx-0 -- cat /data/payload.txt; kubectl -n telemetry-8fb7 get pod influx-0 -o jsonpath='{.spec.containers[0].env}'

sleep 15; kubectl -n telemetry-8fb7 get sts,pvc,pods; kubectl -n telemetry-8fb7 exec influx-0 -- cat /data/payload.txt; kubectl -n telemetry-8fb7 get pod influx-0 -o jsonpath='{.spec.containers[0].env}'
